# Bullet instances reference

Covers named bullet instances across levels, geometry-specific definitions,
equivalent geometry from different attributes, fractional spacing, and item
geometry overrides. Ordered format/start metadata on an unordered container does
not change its bullet marker; the capture reported those controls as unsupported.
Bullet restart metadata does not create new instances for the same identity and
definition. An unnamed bullet instance is keyed by its base level.

All package parts and the evaluated model are compared. Real Word rendering and
layout review remain **unreviewed**.
